name: EMA crossover
desc: Hold long while the fast EMA is above the slow EMA. Simple and slow to react in sideways markets.

name: RSI mean reversion
desc: Buy when RSI drops below a floor and exit when it recovers. Struggles in strong downtrends.

name: Opening range breakout
desc: Trade the first break of the opening range and close at day end. Needs intraday data.

name: Band-rebalanced basket
desc: Hold target weights across ETFs, gold and crypto and trade only when an asset drifts past a band. Far fewer trades than calendar rebalancing.

name: ATR risk sizing
desc: Size each trade so a 2-ATR stop loses a fixed small percent of equity. Works with any signal.

name: Pre-trade risk gate
desc: Blocks orders over size, position, daily-loss or daily-count limits, outside hours, or when a KILL file exists.
